task: Add Milestone 1 read-only policy discovery for the isolated koala authority enforce subsystem.
outcome: User runs koala authority enforce policy --authorityURL=http://127.0.0.1:PORT against a fake Python authority endpoint and sees: Authority policy discovery only: no receipt, no gate pass, no evidence submission. contractVersion=authority-policy.v1 requiredAuthorityMode=enforce preset=anti-hallucination commandCatalogDigest=... evidenceSchemaDigest=...
facts: B-7e38 recorded the subsystem boundary: ordinary Koala workflow remains a thin client, while future koala authority enforce work is isolated and opt-in.
PD-2 means the authority-client role decision that separates CLI discovery/transport from Python authority receipts and Mac Runner execution.
cord-team is the Python authority server repository whose GET /v1/authority/policy endpoint owns the authority-policy.v1 discovery contract.
Python authority policy discovery is read-only and explicitly does not issue receipts, signatures, gate passes, or evidence acceptance.
Existing Koala authority evidence flow supports POST /v1/evidence and /v1/evidence/batch; this story must not broaden that path into production L2+ authority.
constraints: Follow Koala lifecycle: PLAN artifacts first, scope review before DEV, implementation by Claude Code CLI, Codex verifies.
Do not implement actor keys, runner registration, job claiming, provider execution, evidence submission, receipt verification, or gate promotion in this milestone.
The new command must be read-only from the Koala story perspective and must not write local evidence files.
The client must reject or flag overclaim policy responses containing receipt, receiptId, gatePassed, or accepted.
Existing authority-boundary, authority-client, and authority-evidence-flow smokes must keep passing.
